Western blot assays were performed as described previously [36]. Briefly, cell lysates were prepared in cold RIPA buffer (Solarbio, #R0010) containing InStab™ Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (EDTA-free) (Yeasen, #20124ES03) and InStab™ Phosphatase Inhibitor Cocktail (Yeasen, #20109ES05). The cell lysates were centrifuged at 15,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, and cell protein amounts were quantified with a Pierce BCA protein assay kit (Thermo Fisher, #23,227). Western blot assays were performed using standard techniques with the following antibodies in this study: MSI2 (Abcam, #ab76148), HSPB1 (PTMBIO, #PTM-6188), P-HSPB1(Ser78) (PTMBIO, #PTM-6652), TFRC (Affinity, #AF5343), FTH1 (Affinity, #DF6278), ACSL4 (PTMBIO, #PTM-6141), GPX4 (Abcam, #ab125066), actin (Sungene Biotech, #KM9001T), β-tubulin (Sungene Biotech, #KM9003T), P42/44 (CST, #4695S), P-P42/44 (CST, #4370S), P38 (ZENBIO, #200,782), P-P38 (ZENBIO, #310,091), MAPKAPK2 (ZENBIO, #R27028), P-MAPKAPK2 (ZENBIO, #310,236), MAPK13 (ZENBIO, #310,008), PCNA (ZENBIO, #200947-2E1), HRP Conjugated Goat anti-Rabbit IgG (HUABIO, #HA1001), and HRP Conjugated Goat anti-Mouse IgG (HUABIO, #HA1006). And grayscale analysis of western blotting results was performed using Image-J software.

Flow cytometric analysis was performed to examine the mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP), the levels of ROS and lipid ROS, and the percentage of dead cells. Briefly, SW620, LOVO and HT29 stable cell lines were seeded in 6-well plates for 24 h, washed twice with 1 × PBS, and then incubated with reagents from the JC-1 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential Assay Kit (LABLEAD, #J22202), CellROX™ Deep Red (H2DCFDA) (Invitrogen, #C10422), BODIPY™ 581/591 C11 (C11-BODIPY) (Invitrogen, #D3861) and Annexin V-APC Cell Death Detection Kit (KeyGEN BioTECH, #KGA1021) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Finally, the stained cells were washed twice with 1 × PBS and then analyzed on a Beckman CytoFlex flow cytometer (Beckman, USA). The positive cell percentages and mean fluorescence intensity were calculated by using FlowJo v10 software.

We performed immunohistochemical staining as previously described [22]. Briefly, IHC was carried out on paraffin-embedded CRC or in vivo model tumor tissues. The sections were then subjected to gradient hydration and heat-induced antigen retrieval and incubated with MSI2 (Abcam, #ab76148), HSPB1 (PTMBIO, #PTM-6188), P-HSPB1(Ser78) (PTMBIO, #PTM-6652), ACSL4 (PTMBIO, #PTM-6141), P-P38 (ZENBIO, #310,091), PCNA (ZENBIO, #200947-2E1) and Ki67 (Servicebio, #GB111499) antibodies at 4 °C overnight. Immunohistochemical staining was visualized with diaminobenzidine (DAB) techniques. The IHC images were scanned and captured with a Leica Aperio Versa 200 microscope, and the integrated optical density per area (IOD/area) of each IHC image was analyzed by Image-Pro Plus software.

steps.title: Maintain colorectal cancer cell lines
steps.instruction: Obtain LOVO, SW620 and HT29 cells from the Type Culture Collection of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (Shanghai, China) with STR certification. Culture them in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (HyClone) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (Gibco) and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin (HyClone) at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Determine viability with CCK‑8
steps.instruction: Assess cell viability using Cell Counting Kit‑8 (Yeasen, #40203ES76) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Perform colony formation assay
steps.instruction: Resuspend stable CRC cells and seed 1 000 cells per well into 6‑well plates. Incubate for 14 days at 37 °C in a humidified incubator, then fix with 4 % paraformaldehyde and stain with 0.1 % crystal violet to count colonies.

steps.title: Conduct Transwell migration/invasion assay
steps.instruction: Carry out migration and invasion assays as described in reference [36]. After the assay, stain the membrane, cut it, mount on a microscope slide and count cells in four random fields at 10× magnification.

steps.title: Induce or inhibit ferroptosis
steps.instruction: Treat stable CRC cells with erastin (Selleck, #S7242) or ferrostatin‑1 (Selleck, #S7243) for 8–24 h, then examine the corresponding phenotypes.

steps.title: Measure intracellular iron and GSH
steps.instruction: Determine total iron, ferrous iron and reduced glutathione using the Cell Total Iron Colorimetric Assay Kit (Elabscience, #E‑BC‑K880‑M), Cell Ferrous Iron Colorimetric Assay Kit (Elabscience, #E‑BC‑K881‑M) and Reduced Glutathione (GSH) Assay Kit (Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering, #A006‑2‑1) respectively, following each manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Lyse cells or tissues with TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, #15,596,026) and extract total RNA according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA and run qRT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe RNA using Fast‑King gDNA Dispelling RT Super Mix (TIANGEN, #KR118). Perform quantitative PCR on a Roche LightCycler480 II using Super Real Pre‑Mix Plus (SYBR Green, TIANGEN, #FP205). Use the 2⁻ΔΔCt method for relative quantification with β‑actin as the endogenous control. Primer sequences: β‑actin F AAGGTGACAGCAGTCGGTT R TGTGTGGACTTGGGAGAGG; MSI2 F ATCCCACTACGAAACGCTCC R GGGGTCAATCGTCTTGGAATC; HSPB1 F TGGACCCCACCCAAGTTTC R CGGCAGTCTCATCGGATTTT; ACSL4 F AGGACATTTAAAAACGCTATGGCA R GTCCCAAGGCTGTCCTTCTT; FTH1 F TGAAGCTGCAGAACCAACGAGG R GCACACTCCATTGCATTCAGCC; GPX4 F GAGGCAAGACCGAAGTAAACTAC R CCGAACTGGTTACACGGGAA.

steps.title: Prepare lysates for western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in cold RIPA buffer (Solarbio, #R0010) containing InStab™ Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (EDTA‑free, Yeasen, #20124ES03) and InStab™ Phosphatase Inhibitor Cocktail (Yeasen, #20109ES05). Centrifuge lysates at 15 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Quantify protein concentration with Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher, #23,227).

steps.title: Run western blot and detect proteins
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE, transfer to a membrane and block. Incubate membranes overnight at 4 °C with primary antibodies: MSI2 (Abcam, #ab76148), HSPB1 (PTMBIO, #PTM‑6188), P‑HSPB1(Ser78) (PTMBIO, #PTM‑6652), TFRC (Affinity, #AF5343), FTH1 (Affinity, #DF6278), ACSL4 (PTMBIO, #PTM‑6141), GPX4 (Abcam, #ab125066), actin (Sungene Biotech, #KM9001T), β‑tubulin (Sungene Biotech, #KM9003T), P42/44 (CST, #4695S), P‑P42/44 (CST, #4370S), P38 (ZENBIO, #200,782), P‑P38 (ZENBIO, #310,091), MAPKAPK2 (ZENBIO, #R27028), P‑MAPKAPK2 (ZENBIO, #310,236), MAPK13 (ZENBIO, #310,008), PCNA (ZENBIO, #200947‑2E1). After washing, incubate with HRP‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG (HUABIO, #HA1001) or HRP‑conjugated goat anti‑mouse IgG (HUABIO, #HA1006). Visualize bands and perform grayscale analysis with Image‑J software.

steps.title: Analyze mitochondrial and oxidative parameters by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Seed SW620, LOVO and HT29 stable lines in 6‑well plates for 24 h. Wash twice with 1× PBS and incubate with reagents from: JC‑1 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential Assay Kit (LABLEAD, #J22202), CellROX™ Deep Red (Invitrogen, #C10422), BODIPY™ 581/591 C11 (Invitrogen, #D3861) and Annexin V‑APC Cell Death Detection Kit (KeyGEN BioTECH, #KGA1021) according to manufacturers’ instructions. Wash twice with PBS, then acquire data on a Beckman CytoFlex flow cytometer. Calculate positive‑cell percentages and mean fluorescence intensity using FlowJo v10.

steps.title: Submit samples for 4D label‑free proteomics
steps.instruction: Send stable SW620 cell lysates to PTM Biolab (Hangzhou, China) for 4D label‑free proteomic analysis. Analyze differentially expressed proteins with GO, KEGG, subcellular localization (Wolfpsort), COG/KOG and GSEA. Use a two‑tailed Fisher’s exact test; consider p < 0.05 as significant.

steps.title: Perform H&E staining on tissue samples
steps.instruction: Fix fresh CRC, xenograft tumors or metastatic tissues in 4 % paraformaldehyde at 4 °C overnight. Embed in paraffin, section, stain with hematoxylin and eosin, dehydrate through an alcohol gradient and xylene. Observe and photograph sections using a Leica Aperio Versa 200 microscope.

steps.title: Conduct immunohistochemical staining
steps.instruction: Process paraffin‑embedded tumor sections with gradient hydration and heat‑induced antigen retrieval. Incubate overnight at 4 °C with primary antibodies: MSI2 (Abcam, #ab76148), HSPB1 (PTMBIO, #PTM‑6188), P‑HSPB1(Ser78) (PTMBIO, #PTM‑6652), ACSL4 (PTMBIO, #PTM‑6141), P‑P38 (ZENBIO, #310,091), PCNA (ZENBIO, #200947‑2E1) and Ki67 (Servicebio, #GB111499). Visualize with DAB, scan images on a Leica Aperio Versa 200 microscope and quantify integrated optical density per area using Image‑Pro Plus software.

steps.title: Execute bioinformatic and database analyses
steps.instruction: Use GEPIA2 to compare MSI2 transcription in normal vs tumor tissue; TIMER for Spearman correlations with ferroptosis‑related genes; UALCAN CPTAC for MSI2 protein levels; GEO datasets GSE14333 and GSE17536 for survival curves via Kaplan‑Meier and log‑rank test; TCGA for differential ferroptosis genes and KEGG enrichment in MSI2‑high/low groups; DepMap and DEMETER2 for gene effect scores; FerrDb for ferroptosis driver/suppressor lists; STRING for PPI networks of HSPB1 and MAPK family genes. Perform Pearson or Spearman correlation as appropriate.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis of data
steps.instruction: Analyze experimental results with GraphPad Prism 7.5. Apply two‑tailed unpaired or paired Student’s t‑test or Wilcoxon test for two‑group comparisons; one‑way ANOVA or Kruskal‑Wallis test for >2 groups. Present data as mean ± standard deviation of three independent experiments. Consider p < 0.05 significant and annotate as *p < 0.05, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001, ****p < 0.0001, ns not significant.
